# 📊 NBFC Daily Watch — Sunday, October 25, 2026

*Monday, Oct 26, 2026 edition. Markets were shut over the weekend, so Indian prices below are Friday's (23 Oct) close and labelled that way. Gold spot and Brent are this morning's Asian-hours prints. Muthoot Fincorp Ltd is a separate company from Muthoot Finance Ltd; Muthoot Finance appears here as a listed lender.*

## 🔴 URGENT / High Impact

**1. The rural-stress story moved from one lender's call to an industry theme. Shriram, Mahindra Finance, L&T Finance and HDB are all lending more cautiously in drought pockets, and two rating agencies have named microfinance as a pressure point.**
- Mint's lead this morning (26 Oct, 06:00 IST) puts the Q2 calls side by side. The monsoon ended at **87% of LPA, the weakest since 2015**. September CPI rose to **5.54%** (4.83% in August), with food inflation at **7.74%** (5.97%). ([Mint](https://www.livemint.com/news/nbfcs-turn-cautious-on-rural-lending-as-weak-monsoon-threatens-repayments-11792921724354.html))
- **Shriram Finance:** Umesh Revankar named **Maharashtra, Karnataka and Telangana** as the worst-hit states where it has a sizable presence. GS2 is **7.04%** (6.96% in Q1) and credit cost is **2.03%** (1.68% a year ago).
- **Mahindra Finance:** Raul Rebello said **282 districts** have been classified as drought-prone, and the company has cut funding in some stressed markets. InCred says tractor disbursements fell **20% QoQ**. Its asset quality still improved, with GS3 at 3.4% (3.9%).
- **L&T Finance:** rural disbursements were **₹6,356 cr, −9% QoQ** (+1% YoY). The rural book is ₹33,465 cr (+22% YoY).
- The agencies disagree on timing:
  - **Jinay Gala (India Ratings):** "Microfinance, unsecured business loans and, to some extent, tractor financing could face pressure… from December onwards."
  - **Sanjay Agarwal (CareEdge):** it is more likely to show in **Q4 than Q3**, and "may not show up in microfinance just yet".
> **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** Two of Shriram's three worst-hit states, Karnataka and Telangana, are in Muthoot Fincorp's southern footprint. The monsoon-sensitive exposure sits mainly in non-gold retail books and, on a consolidated basis, in the Muthoot Microfin JLG book (see the deep dive).

**2. Gold opened the week below $4,000/oz, near a three-month low, with FOMC due Tuesday–Wednesday. Brent eased 1.3% even though the Houthis attacked Saudi Arabia over the weekend.**
- Spot gold was **$3,992.97/oz** at 5:50 AM IST, roughly flat and "near a more-than-three-month low". Investors are holding back ahead of this week's Fed decision. ([ET Now Swadesh](https://hindi.etnownews.com/personal-finance/gold-price-today-26-october-2026-10-gram-sone-ka-bhav-1-kg-chandi-kimat-delhi-mumbai-news-in-hindi-24k-22k-18k-gold-jewellery-rates-article-156405584))
- MCX December gold last traded at **₹1,42,150/10g (−₹1,159, −0.81%)** on Friday night, down **3.98% on the week**. ([Upstox MCX](https://upstox.com/commodity-market-trading/mcx-gold-price/))
- Brent was **$115.16 (−1.34%)** in early Monday trade, after a 6% gain last week, despite weekend Houthi attacks on a Saudi airport and oil facilities. ([Nation Thailand](https://www.nationthailand.com/news/world/40072732))
> **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** Gold prices set the loan-to-value cushion on gold loans, and this week's gold price depends on the Fed's guidance. Oil above $115 keeps upward pressure on NBFC funding costs, including NCD and bank-line pricing.


## 🏢 Muthoot Fincorp in the market

- **Tranche I public NCD issue (open 23 Oct – 5 Nov 2026).** Bidding resumes today. Bids stood at 0.55 times the ₹200 cr base issue as of 17:00 on 23 Oct: retail 0.32×, HNI 0.69×, non-institutional 0.71×, institutional 0.00×. The issue is ₹200 cr base plus ₹300 cr green shoe, allotted first come, first served, and closes Thu 5 Nov. [Chittorgarh](https://www.chittorgarh.com/bond/muthoot-fincorp-tranche-i-ncd-october-2026/399/)
- **Subsidiary.** Muthoot Microfin, Muthoot Fincorp's listed microfinance subsidiary, has called a board meeting for 5 Nov 2026 to approve results for the quarter and half-year to 30 Sep. ([StockFin](https://www.stockfin.ai/news/MUTHOOTMF/2026-10-23/board-meeting))

## 💰 Financial Results & Performance

- **Piramal Finance: five years after DHFL (NIE, 25 Oct).** The IBC-resolved DHFL book has produced **₹3,000 cr+ in gains on stressed loans**, and Piramal keeps **₹16,000 cr of tax losses** to set off. ([New Indian Express](https://www.newindianexpress.com/business/2026/Oct/25/five-years-after-dhfl-buyout-piramal-finance-gains-rs-3000-crore-from-stressed-loans))
  - The legacy AUM is down to **₹1,673 cr**, or **1.5% of AUM**, with ₹459 cr of provisions still held.
  - A **₹90 cr recovery gain** pulled Q2 credit cost to **1.1%** (1.8% in Q1). NIM is 6.5%, consolidated PAT **₹545 cr (+67%)** and AUM **₹1,13,112 cr (+24%)**.
  - **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** the case shows how recoveries on old loans can lower reported credit cost, which analysts may look for in other lenders' Q2 numbers.
- **Pricing signal: GIC Housing Finance** is raising its **BPLR 25 bp, from 17.70% to 17.95%, from 1 Nov** (board circular resolution, 25 Oct). ([StockFin / exchange filing](https://www.stockfin.ai/news/GICHSGFIN/2026-10-25/board-meeting))
  - **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** it shows a listed lender passing higher funding costs through to floating-rate borrowers, a step other NBFCs with benchmark-linked products may also take.
- **This week:**
  - PTC India Financial Q2 on **27 Oct**.
  - **Cholamandalam** and **PNB Housing** on **28 Oct**.
  - **Muthoot Microfin** on **5 Nov**.
  - Manappuram has no board intimation yet; the 14 Nov LODR deadline applies.
  - ([StockWatch – PFS](https://www.stockwatch.live/in/news/ptc-india-financial-services-pfs-board-to-consider-q2-h1-fy27-results-on-oct-27-35c6a2bf-368e-4599-8bc6-ee80975a7a0c), [StockWatch – Chola](https://www.stockwatch.live/in/news/cholamandalam-investment-trading-window-closed-for-q2-results-31e0d9f9-df8c-475f-a63b-f38a4cb6db50), [AlphaStreet – PNB Housing](https://alphastreet.com/india/pnb-housing-finance-ltd-pnbhousing-earnings-call-invite-for-the-2nd-quarter-and-half-year-ended-september-30-2026/), [Manappuram board meetings](https://www.manappuram.com/board-meeting), [StockFin – Muthoot Microfin](https://www.stockfin.ai/news/MUTHOOTMF/2026-10-23/board-meeting))

- No significant developments today. No fresh NBFC rating action was confirmed for 24–25 Oct.
- Muthoot Fincorp's ratings are unchanged: CRISIL AA/Stable and Brickwork AA+/Stable on Tranche I ([Chittorgarh](https://www.chittorgarh.com/bond/muthoot-fincorp-tranche-i-ncd-october-2026/399/)), and CARE AA/Stable from 5 Oct ([CARE PR](https://www.careratings.com/upload/CompanyFiles/PR/202610121058_Muthoot_Fincorp_Limited.pdf)).

## 📉 NPA & Asset Quality

- **CreditAccess Grameen: drought requests are starting in central Maharashtra** (ETBFSI Research, 24 Oct, from Axis Securities' post-results note). ([ETBFSI](https://bfsi.economictimes.indiatimes.com/articles/drought-hit-maharashtra-borrowers-seek-repayment-extensions-creditaccess-warns-of-higher-q3-credit-costs/135159303))
  - Borrowers there are asking for more time to repay, including possible **restructuring**. CAGL is putting existing customers ahead of new sourcing.
  - It expects **higher Q3 credit costs** but is holding full-year guidance at **3–4%**. It added a **45 bp provisioning buffer**, taking ECL to **3.31%**. Management says risk-adjusted margins can absorb **4.5–5%** credit cost.
  - It sees no comparable stress in other geographies. Collections in the flood-hit northern states have normalised.
- **Rural books:** Mint's cross-lender read is in Urgent #1. Shriram GS3 is 4.65% (4.64% in Q1), Mahindra Finance GS3 3.4%, and credit costs are rising at Shriram. ([Mint](https://www.livemint.com/news/nbfcs-turn-cautious-on-rural-lending-as-weak-monsoon-threatens-repayments-11792921724354.html))
- **ARC / IBC:** Piramal's DHFL recoveries are above. There were no new ARC transactions over the weekend.

## 👤 Personnel & Leadership

- **Asirvad Micro Finance** (Manappuram's subsidiary) has elevated **G.D. Manoj Pasangha to MD & CEO**. Asirvad's portfolio is about **₹8,000 cr**, roughly 70% of it microfinance. ([BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/asirvad-micro-finance-elevates-pasangha-as-its-md-ceo/article71612866.ece))
  - **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** Asirvad competes with Muthoot Microfin, Muthoot Fincorp's microfinance subsidiary, in southern JLG markets, and a new CEO often brings a fresh growth push.
- **HDFC Bank:** Anup Bagchi starts as CEO tomorrow (27 Oct). This was already flagged.

## 🏘️ Sector Deep Dive — Monday: Microfinance & SHG lending

### The microfinance recovery is real, but it is still narrow, and the drought is the first test

**1. The portfolio has bottomed but isn't growing with new borrowers.** Infomerics' October 2026 outlook draws on CRIF High Mark. ([Infomerics](https://infomericstorage.blob.core.windows.net/uploads/mfi_report_oct26_bbfd906019.pdf))
- Industry GLP fell from **₹3.81 lakh cr** (Mar-25) to **₹3.21 lakh cr** (Dec-25), then rose to **₹3.33 lakh cr** (Jun-26), which is **−7.3% YoY** and +0.6% QoQ.
- Live borrowers fell from **8.0 cr to 6.6 cr** over the year, while the average ticket size of new loans rose to **₹62,000**.
- **57%** of originations went to repeat borrowers.
- In short, the recovery is coming from larger loans to repeat customers.

**2. Asset quality is clean, for now** (Infomerics/CRIF).
- **PAR 1–180** fell from **7.6%** (Mar-25) to **2.3%** (Jun-26), and PAR 91–180 to **0.8%**.
- Borrowers with **two or fewer lenders** are now **80.9%**, and those with five or more lenders **1.1%**.
- The guardrails are working. The open question is what happens to these ratios when farm incomes take an 87%-of-LPA hit.

**3. The listed MFIs are growing again and diversifying out of JLG.**

| CreditAccess Grameen | GNPA **1.79%** (2.18%); NIM guidance raised to **14.4–14.7%**; retail finance **23.3%** of AUM (11.1% a year ago); microfinance growth guided at 10–12% within 20–25% AUM growth | [ETBFSI](https://bfsi.economictimes.indiatimes.com/articles/drought-hit-maharashtra-borrowers-seek-repayment-extensions-creditaccess-warns-of-higher-q3-credit-costs/135159303) |

| **Muthoot Microfin** (Muthoot Fincorp subsidiary, provisional) | AUM **₹15,323 cr (+22%)**; cost of funds **9.93%**, its first single-digit print; collection efficiency **98.11%**; JLG:non-JLG **69:31**; **₹453 cr of gold loans disbursed by co-lending with parent Muthoot Fincorp** | [BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/stock-markets/muthoot-microfin-aum-crosses-15300-crore-cost-of-funds-enters-single-digits/article71559184.ece) |

**4. The drought is the first real test.**
- CAGL's central-Maharashtra extension requests are the first company-level sign. Ind-Ra flags microfinance pressure from December, while CareEdge thinks microfinance is too early in its recovery to show it yet. ([ETBFSI](https://bfsi.economictimes.indiatimes.com/articles/drought-hit-maharashtra-borrowers-seek-repayment-extensions-creditaccess-warns-of-higher-q3-credit-costs/135159303), [Mint](https://www.livemint.com/news/nbfcs-turn-cautious-on-rural-lending-as-weak-monsoon-threatens-repayments-11792921724354.html))
- **SHG–bank linkage:** there is no new data this week, so no significant developments today.

> **Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:** Muthoot Microfin's 5 Nov results feed into the consolidated ROMA that CARE tracks against its below-2.50% downgrade trigger for Muthoot Fincorp ([CARE](https://www.careratings.com/upload/CompanyFiles/PR/202610121058_Muthoot_Fincorp_Limited.pdf)). The ₹453 cr gold co-lending line links the two books. Points to watch on 5 Nov: whether Muthoot Microfin adds a provisioning buffer like CAGL's, its exposure to drought districts, and whether the shift away from JLG holds.

# 📋 NBFC Weekly Analysis: Week of 19–25 October 2026

*Published Monday, 26 October 2026 (IST). Covers trading sessions Mon 19, Wed 21, Thu 22 and Fri 23 October (markets shut Tue 20 Oct for Dussehra) plus weekend news. Muthoot Fincorp Ltd is a Middle Layer NBFC with unlisted equity and listed NCDs. Muthoot Finance Ltd is a separate, listed company; none of its numbers are Muthoot Fincorp's.*

## Executive Summary

- **Gold-loan stress stopped being a footnote.** In one week, three large lenders put numbers on it. Bajaj Finance's Stage 2+3 rose ₹1,601 cr in Q2, ₹1,047 cr of it gold, and it has dropped its short-tenor gold schemes ([CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/bajaj-finance-share-price-q2fy27-results-net-profit-nii-rises-asset-quality-strong-20015184.htm)). Piramal's CEO said 15–23% of FY26 industry gold disbursements went to borrowers already 90+ days overdue elsewhere ([Business Standard](https://www.business-standard.com/finance/personal-finance/large-non-bank-lenders-flag-early-signs-of-stress-in-gold-loan-portfolios-126102101390_1.html)). Shriram Finance's gold-loan gross Stage 3 rose to 3.12% from 2.57% in Q1 ([VCCircle/Reuters](https://www.vccircle.com/shriramfinance-joins-peers-in-flagging-stress-in-gold-loans)).
- **Gold and the gold-lender stocks fell together.** Spot gold lost 3.6% on the week to $4,021.04/oz, and MCX December gold went from ₹1,47,300 on Monday to about ₹1.42 lakh/10g on Friday ([HDFC Sky](https://hdfcsky.com/news/gold-slumps-3-6percent-in-worst-week-since-june-silver-crashes-below-54-as-oil-fuelled-rate-fears-wipe-out-festive-gains-2)). Listed gold lenders fell much more than the index. IIFL Finance lost 13.6% on the week, Manappuram 11.7% and Muthoot Finance 8.7%, against −3.88% for Nifty Financial Services (NSE closes, see table).
- **Funding costs kept rising.** The 10-year G-sec ended Friday at 7.474%, its tenth straight weekly loss and the worst run in three decades ([Reuters via FE](https://today.thefinancialexpress.com.bd/public/index.php/print/indias-10-year-bond-falls-for-10th-week-in-record-slump-1792771734)). The MPC minutes said a cut is off the table and the next move is a hike or a pause ([Moneycontrol](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/rbi-mpc-minutes-signal-rate-hike-or-pause-2-members-oppose-stance-change-14056907.html)). Brent settled at $116.72 ([CNA/Reuters](https://www.channelnewsasia.com/business/oil-prices-jump-3-houthi-attacks-oil-spill-highest-settlement-april-6484841)).
- **Q2 profits are strong. Margins and stock prices are not.** Shriram (+59%), M&M Finance (+55%), CreditAccess Grameen (roughly 4×), Piramal (+67%) and Bajaj Finance (+29%) all posted big profit growth, yet most of these stocks fell. M&M Finance hit a 52-week low after NIM slipped 30 bps QoQ ([Moneycontrol](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/markets/m-m-financial-shares-fall-up-to-10-to-hit-52-week-low-despite-55-yoy-profit-in-q2-brokerages-cut-target-price-14057760.html)).
- **Muthoot Fincorp's week: Tranche I NCD issue opened.** The ₹500 cr public NCD issue (₹200 cr base + ₹300 cr green shoe) opened on 23 Oct; bids stood at 0.55× at the end of day 1. It closes on 5 Nov ([Chittorgarh](https://www.chittorgarh.com/bond/muthoot-fincorp-tranche-i-ncd-october-2026/399/)). No new RBI instrument addressed to NBFCs came out after 19 Oct (UAPA list update).

Weekly percentages are computed from these closes.

## 🏛️ Regulatory & Policy Watch

**1. MPC minutes (published 21 Oct): no cut in sight.** The 5–7 Oct meeting voted unanimously to raise repo 25 bps to 5.50% and moved the stance to "calibrated tightening". Two members, Nagesh Kumar and Ram Singh, backed the hike but opposed the stance change. FY27 CPI forecast is 5.2% and GDP 7.1% ([RBI](https://www.rbi.org.in/scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63839), [Moneycontrol](https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/business/rbi-mpc-minutes-signal-rate-hike-or-pause-2-members-oppose-stance-change-14056907.html)).
- *Direct impact:* bank term loans and CP reprice upward with a lag. Bajaj Finance has already said H2 NIM compression may exceed its 10–15 bps guide ([CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/bajaj-finance-share-price-q2-result-reaction-fy27-guidance-aum-margin-repo-rate-buy-sell-target-outlook-20015660.htm)).
- *Second order:* the two dissents on stance mean the tightening bias is not unanimous. If oil cools, December could be a pause, not a hike.
- *Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:* bank lines are where higher rates would show up first, since retail NCDs already issued carry fixed rates for the life of the paper.

**2. Governor on Upper Layer listing (speech, 23 Oct).** Governor Malhotra said UL NBFCs, and CICs that use public funds, must register and list. He was backing RBI's treatment of Tata Sons ([ET](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/company/corporate-trends/rbi-governor-backs-tata-sons-classification-says-large-nbfcs-must-follow-listing-norms/articleshow/135149254.cms)).
- *Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:* this is a speech, not a circular. Muthoot Fincorp is Middle Layer and not on the UL list, so the listing mandate does not apply to it. Muthoot Finance is UL and already listed. Muthoot Fincorp's own IPO plan (₹3,000 cr fresh-issue DRHP, filed August) is voluntary ([Fortune India](https://www.fortuneindia.com/markets/ipo/gold-lender-muthoot-fincorp-files-drhp-for-3000-crore-fresh-issue-ipo/153754)).

**3. RBI Bulletin study, "Performance of the NBFC Sector: Review for 2025" (23 Oct).** NBFCs' share of financial-sector assets fell to 12.7% (Mar 2025) from 13.9% (Mar 2020). UL+ML loans grew 24% to Dec 2025, gold-jewellery loans were up nearly 60%, GNPA was 2.7%, NNPA 0.9% and CRAR 25.2%. Borrowings rose 23.3%, more than 77% of them from banks and market instruments ([BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/nbfcs-lose-ground-despite-stronger-profitability-better-asset-quality-rbi-study/article71617268.ece), [Business Standard](https://www.business-standard.com/industry/banking/nbfcs-reliance-on-bank-borrowings-rises-amid-strong-credit-growth-rbi-126102301611_1.html)).
- *Second order:* this is staff research, not a rule. But "bank interconnectedness" is the language RBI used before it raised bank risk weights on NBFC loans in 2023. The December FSR is the next place it could appear.

**4. Circulars actually issued this week.** RBI/2026-27/296 (19 Oct) updated three UNSC 1267 entries for UAPA screening. Every other RBI circular in the week was bank-only (capital adequacy, leverage ratio) or FEMA compounding. SEBI's only circular was on research-analyst call records ([RBI notifications](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/NotificationUser.aspx), [SEBI](https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebiweb/home/HomeAction.do?doListing=yes&sid=1&ssid=7&smid=0)).
- *Possible impact on Muthoot Fincorp:* like all regulated entities, it applies the updated screening list; there is no P&L impact.

**Live threads with dates:** SEBI's Credit Risk-o-Meter for debt offer documents goes live around 21 Nov. Under it, a CRISIL AA rating such as Muthoot Fincorp's would map to "very low" risk ([SEBI circular](https://www.sebi.gov.in/legal/circulars/oct-2026/introduction-of-credit-risk-o-meter-as-an-additional-disclosure-mechanism-for-debt-securities_105081.html)). Account-aggregator data fees start 1 Nov ([ET](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/startups/new-account-aggregator-pricing-may-force-lenders-to-redraft-all-tech-pacts/articleshow/135099078.cms)). The recovery-agent directions apply from 1 Jan 2027. The IRDAI commission-cap draft, the GST panel's 18% proposal on co-lending services ([BW](https://www.businessworld.in/article/gst-panel-proposes-18-tax-on-nbfc-co-lending-services-627474)) and RBI's revolving-credit draft are all still pending.

Sources: [Bajaj (CNBC-TV18)](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/bajaj-finance-share-price-q2-result-reaction-fy27-guidance-aum-margin-repo-rate-buy-sell-target-outlook-20015660.htm), [Piramal (Financial Express)](https://www.financialexpress.com/business/industry-piramal-finance-q2-results-profit-jumps-67-to-rs-545-crore-nii-rises-35-4364842/), [M&M Finance press release](https://www.bseindia.com/xml-data/corpfiling/AttachLive/23b38c72-a8df-4835-8e07-3c8988393f66.pdf), [Aye Finance (BusinessLine)](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/q2-results-today-live-updates-eternal-adani-green-indian-hotels-srf-vishal-mega-mafrt-kei-ind-mampm-financial-services-pc-jeweller-company-results-21-october-2026/article71606182.ece), [CreditAccess (CNBC-TV18)](https://www.cnbctv18.com/market/stocks/creditaccess-grameen-share-price-q2-results-profit-jumps-4-fold-as-credit-costs-fall-43-fy27-guidance-raised-20017322.htm), [Paisalo release](https://www.bseindia.com/xml-data/corpfiling/AttachLive/1ccf0873-b9f1-4768-8b4d-35a031bc7b75.pdf), [Shriram (ET)](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/earnings/shriram-finance-q2-profit-jumps-59-yoy-to-rs-3677-crore-on-strong-interest-income-lower-funding-costs/articleshow/135150195.cms), [Shriram gold (VCCircle/Reuters)](https://www.vccircle.com/shriramfinance-joins-peers-in-flagging-stress-in-gold-loans), [SBFC (Free Press Journal)](https://www.freepressjournal.in/business/sbfc-finance-reports-strong-q2-fy27-results-net-profit-up-2724-to-13887-crore-half-year-profit-climbs-2808).

Bajaj warned of more NIM compression. - **Microfinance has turned.** CreditAccess's PAR 90+ is at a 10-quarter low and it cut lending rates by 50 bps from October. Aye's credit cost fell for a seventh straight quarter.
- **Gold lenders have not reported yet.** Muthoot Finance has not announced a Q2 date; trackers estimate early November based on past years ([finanzen](https://www.finanzen.at/termine/muthoot_finance)). Manappuram is expected around 9 Nov ([finanzen.net](https://www.finanzen.net/termine/manappuram_finance)). Muthoot Fincorp's Q2 falls under the 14 Nov LODR deadline for listed-debt issuers.

## 💳 Credit & Lending Trends

- **Bank credit growth slowed to 18.2% YoY** in the fortnight to 15 Oct, from 19.4% at end-September. Credit fell ₹2.52 lakh cr and deposits ₹5.19 lakh cr in the fortnight, the usual unwind after quarter-end. Deposit growth is 16.7% and the CD ratio is 81.59% ([RBI WSS](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_ViewWssExtractdetails.aspx?id=63855), [ET](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/banking/banks-see-5-19-lakh-crore-deposit-outflow-credit-shrinks-2-52-lakh-crore/articleshow/135147095.cms)).
- **Gold is still the fastest-growing retail category.** At end-August, bank gold loans were ₹5.6 trn (+83% YoY) and NBFC gold loans ₹3.6 trn (+69%) ([India Today/Reuters](https://www.indiatoday.in/business/story/top-nbfcs-flag-early-signs-of-stress-in-indias-fast-growing-gold-loan-market-3022508-2026-10-22)). Macquarie now calls gold loans India's second-largest retail lending category after mortgages ([TOI](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/surge-in-gold-loans-partly-reflects-stress-say-lenders/articleshow/135100957.cms)).
- **Competitors are still adding capacity.** Bajaj added 321 gold branches in Q2 (2,022 total) and targets 2,700–2,800 by FY27-end. L&T Finance's gold book is ₹5,043 cr (+242% YoY). Shriram intends to double gold from about 2.5% to 5% of assets ([NDTV Profit](https://www.ndtvprofit.com/markets/why-shriram-finance-wants-to-double-down-on-gold-loans-despite-repayment-red-flags-12228710)).
- **Lending rates are moving up.** GIC Housing Finance raised its BPLR 25 bps to 17.95% from 1 Nov ([StockFin/BSE filing](https://www.stockfin.ai/news/GICHSGFIN/2026-10-25/board-meeting)). CreditAccess cut its MFI rates by 50 bps, but that is a credit-cost story, not a funding one.
- **Deposit and bond rates:** PNB Housing (AAA) placed NCDs at 8.4552% maturing in 2031 ([Whalesbook](https://www.whalesbook.com/corporate-news/English/bankingfinance/PNB-Housing-Finance-Raises-Rs-25365-Crore-Via-NCD-Private-Placement/6adb0e98c6c6dccbb905246c)).

## ⚠️ Asset Quality Deep Dive

- **Gold: the numbers so far.** Bajaj: gold Stage 2 up ₹1,047 cr QoQ and gold GNPA 0.70% from 0.35% ([EconoTimes](https://econotimes.com/Bajaj-Finance-Ends-Short-Term-Gold-Loan-Schemes-as-Credit-Risk-Rises-1757807)). Shriram: gold GS3 3.12% (2.28% a year ago). IIFL: gold bad loans 0.9% from 0.6% in Q1; Fedbank Stage 3 0.5% from 0.1% ([Mint](https://www.livemint.com/news/gold-loan-stress-nbfc-piramal-bajaj-finance-precious-metal-11792580129138.html)).
- **Two explanations, and both may be true.** Piramal reads it as borrower stress: 15–23% of disbursements went to borrowers 90+ DPD elsewhere, and 35% of gold customers now borrow from a second lender. Shriram reads it as product design: EMI and interest-servicing gold loans create monthly due dates for customers used to bullet repayment. Its LTV including accrued interest is about 72–73% ([NDTV Profit](https://www.ndtvprofit.com/markets/why-shriram-finance-wants-to-double-down-on-gold-loans-despite-repayment-red-flags-12228710)). The system-wide counterpoint is CIBIL's gold-loan delinquency of about 0.3% ([CNBC-TV18](https://www.cnbctv18.com/business/finance/gff-gold-loans-second-largest-credit-segment-1-in-5-borrowers-npa-elsewhere-cibil-19987383.htm)).
- **Collateral cushion.** MCX gold is more than 20% below this year's ₹1.81 lakh peak ([BusinessLine live blog](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/markets/sensex-nifty50-today-stock-market-highlights-23rd-october-2026/article71611889.ece)). On a one-year loan written near the peak at 75% LTV, a 20% fall in gold leaves almost no cushion once accrued interest is added. That is arithmetic, not a forecast.
- **Elsewhere asset quality is improving.** M&M Finance GS2+3 at 8.1% is a multi-year low. CreditAccess PAR 90+ is 1.1%. RBI's study puts sector GNPA at 2.7%.
- **ARC / stressed assets.** Sammaan Capital and Sammaan Finserve put stressed portfolios up for sale again. The data room is open 23 Oct–28 Nov and bids are due 30 Nov ([InsolvencyTracker](https://insolvencytracker.in/2026/10/22/sammaan-capital-subsidiary-put-stressed-loans-on-the-block-again-six-months-after-%E2%82%B95000-crore-arcil-sale/)). No other large ARC deal was reported this week.

## 🔄 Deals & Strategic Moves

- **Muthoot Fincorp, ₹4,000 cr public NCD shelf, Tranche I (opened 23 Oct, closes 5 Nov).** Size is ₹200 cr base + ₹300 cr green shoe. Ratings are CRISIL AA/Stable and BWR AA+/Stable. Bids stood at 0.55× after day 1 (retail 0.32×, HNI 0.69×, institutional 0.00×); the minimum size to proceed is ₹150 cr (75% of base) ([Chittorgarh](https://www.chittorgarh.com/bond/muthoot-fincorp-tranche-i-ncd-october-2026/399/), [Nuvama prospectus](https://www.nuvama.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Muthoot-FinCorp-Limited-Tranche-I-Prospectus-dated-October-19-2026.pdf)). CARE separately rates Muthoot Fincorp's proposed ₹1,600 cr NCDs and ₹1,200 cr sub-debt AA/Stable ([CARE](https://www.careratings.com/upload/CompanyFiles/PR/202610121058_Muthoot_Fincorp_Limited.pdf)).
- **Bajaj Finance ₹17,500 cr raise** (₹11,700 cr QIP + ₹5,800 cr warrants to Bajaj Finserv), subject to shareholder approval ([Gurufocus call notes](https://www.gurufocus.com/news/9133024/bajaj-finance-ltd-bom500034-q2-2027-earnings-call-highlights-265-aum-growth-strong-profitability-and-a-landmark-inr17500-crore-capital-raise)).
- **IIFL Finance** plans a ₹2,500–5,000 cr minority stake sale amid talk of a Fairfax exit ([ET](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/company/corporate-trends/iifl-finance-plans-to-raise-2500-5000-crore-by-selling-stake-amid-fairfax-exit-rumors/articleshow/135034841.cms)).
- **Vegafin raised ₹1,000 cr** (Premji Invest, Norwest, Lok Capital) to buy NBFC Bizloan and build an AI-led MSME lender ([VCCircle](https://www.vccircle.com/premjiinvest-norwest-back-vegafin-s-nbfc-acquisition)).
- **Bank of America has sought CCI approval** for up to 49.9% of Jio Credit ([ET](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/bank-of-america-arm-seeks-cci-nod-for-up-to-49-9-in-jio-credit/articleshow/135049790.cms)).
- **Paisalo Digital** opened a ₹300 cr public NCD tranche. Retail NCD supply is crowding up while Muthoot Fincorp's issue is also open.
- **Jio Platforms IPO** (₹30,213 cr, bids at 22.19 times the shares on offer): allotment 26 Oct, refunds 27 Oct, listing 28 Oct ([Mint](https://www.livemint.com/market/ipo/reliance-jio-platforms-ipo-gmp-allotment-date-listing-date-time-overall-subscription-status-qib-nii-retail-ril-11792812938496.html)).

## 💻 Digital & Innovation Pulse

- **Account-aggregator fees start 1 Nov.** Lenders will pay for data pulls, and fintechs are redrafting their TSP contracts ([ET](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/tech/startups/new-account-aggregator-pricing-may-force-lenders-to-redraft-all-tech-pacts/articleshow/135099078.cms)). CRIF puts AA-enabled lending at about ₹3.82 lakh cr in FY26 ([CRIF](https://www.crifhighmark.com/media/7697/account-aggregator-report-october-26.pdf)).
- **Credit lines on UPI:** HDFC Bank and Axis Bank are preparing full rollouts ([TechShots](https://www.techshotsapp.com/business/major-banks-embrace-upi-credit-lines-for-digital-lending)).
- **AI in the P&L.** Bajaj's AI-driven disbursals were ₹2,744 cr (+112% YoY). Paisalo's headcount is down 11% YoY, which it credits to automation. L&T Finance launched its agentic cross-sell platform ("Project Hercules") in beta ([LTF release](https://www.ltfinance.com/docs/default-source/default-document-library/press-release/q2fy27-financial-results-press-release-financials.pdf)).
- **Digital lenders are going public.** Vaibhav Vyapaar (LoanFront) listed on NSE SME on 21 Oct ([ET](https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/markets/stocks/news/vaibhav-vyapaar-shares-to-list-today-check-gmp-ahead-of-debut/articleshow/135081701.cms)).

## 🌍 Macro Context

- **Growth:** RBI's FY27 GDP forecast is 7.1% (MPC minutes). Bank credit at 18.2% is still well above nominal GDP, so credit demand is not the constraint.
- **Inflation and rates:** RBI projects FY27 CPI at 5.2%, with Q3 at 6.0% and Q4 at 5.7% ([RBI MPC minutes](https://www.rbi.org.in/scripts/BS_PressReleaseDisplay.aspx?prid=63839)). Brent at $116.72 is the main upside risk. The 10-year rose about 28 bps from 7.193% on 6 Oct to 7.474% on 23 Oct ([Business Standard](https://www.business-standard.com/markets/news/bond-yields-rise-nearly-30-bps-in-oct-to-raise-govt-s-interest-burden-126102500377_1.html)).
- **Foreign flows:** FPIs have sold about ₹48,056 cr of Indian equities so far in October, though selling eased this week ([TOI](https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/business/india-business/foreign-investors-withdraw-rs-48056-crore-in-october-as-market-selling-continues/articleshow/135187012.cms)). Forex reserves fell $5.0 bn to $721.0 bn in the week to 16 Oct ([RBI WSS](https://www.rbi.org.in/Scripts/BS_ViewWssExtractdetails.aspx?id=63855)). The India–US 10-year spread is about 251 bps, a four-month high ([BusinessLine](https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/india-us-bond-yield-gap-tops-250-bps-as-g-sec-yield-hits-748-fpi-inflows-uncertain/article71614839.ece)).
- **What this means for NBFC funding:** a weak rupee, FPI outflows and rising G-secs all point to wider corporate bond spreads, not narrower ones. AA retail paper is still selling, but more slowly.
